id.description: Unique identifier for the webhook subscription.

address.description: Destination URI where webhook notifications are sent.

topic.description: Event topic that triggers this webhook.

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the webhook subscription was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the webhook subscription was last updated.

format.description: Serialization format used for payload delivery, such as json or xml.

items.description: Top-level property name included in the delivered payload.

fields.description: List of top-level resource properties sent in the webhook payload.

metafield_namespaces.description: List of metafield namespaces included in webhook payloads.

api_version.description: Shopify Admin API version applied to the webhook payload.

private_metafield_namespaces.description: List of private metafield namespaces included in webhook payloads.

metafield_identifiers.description: List of specific metafield keys and namespaces included in the payload.

webhook.description: Details of the newly created webhook subscription.

description: Response returned upon successfully creating a webhook subscription.
